title: Gulliver of Mars
summary: "Gulliver of Mars" by Edwin Lester Arnold is a novel first published in 1905. This pioneering work combines fantasy and science fiction, following a military man who travels to Mars by magical means. Unlike typical heroes, Gullivar Jones is hapless, stumbling through adventures without fully mastering his circumstances.
